card.name: Numbers just before mL
card.fires_on: The last digit of a number, usually 5 or 0, right before the unit mL in volumes and concentrations. Common in 5 mL teaspoonful and 50 mL or 60 mL amounts.

modes.label: Per 5 mL
modes.description: The digit 5 in 'per 5 mL' or 'each 5 mL' for liquid strengths.

modes.label: Round volumes ending in 0
modes.description: The 0 closing a volume such as 50 or 80 or 60 before mL.

card.writes: It promotes the letter m, suggesting the next piece is the unit starting with m (mL), and suppresses mm.
card.plain: It lights up on the final digit of a volume number when the unit mL comes next.
